name: The Witch's Berceuse
source:
The Witch’s Berceuse is a short, kinetic, gothic visual novel.

Inspired by classic fables, the story revolves around a young girl who feigns blindness to hide her eyes from a wicked countess who doesn’t allow anyone to own things more beautiful than her own.

[From [url=https://grantsables.itch.io/the-witchs-berceuse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《女巫的贝尔塞斯》是一部简短、动感的哥特式视觉小说。

故事受到经典寓言的启发，讲述了一个年轻女孩假装失明，以躲避邪恶伯爵夫人的目光，伯爵夫人不允许任何人拥有比她更美丽的东西。

[来自[url=https://grantsables.itch.io/the-witchs-berceuse]itch.io[/url]]
